Description: Create a consistent, bilingual, accessible foundation shared by web, mobile and authentication experiences.
Define reusable tokens, components and interaction rules derived from the HerdCommand visual direction.

Title 3: US001 - Define design tokens and semantic roles
Description: As a Product designer, I want a governed set of color, spacing, radius, typography and elevation tokens, so that all product surfaces remain visually consistent.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Tokens cover color, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, border and motion.
  • Semantic tokens are separated from raw palette values.
  • Tokens include web and mobile mappings.
  • Token names are documented and versioned.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US002 - Build reusable core component library
Description: As a Frontend developer, I want reusable buttons, inputs, cards, badges, tables and overlays, so that screens can be delivered consistently and faster.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Components include states: default, hover/pressed, focus, disabled, loading and error where applicable.
  • Component variants use design tokens rather than hard-coded values.
  • Components meet keyboard and touch interaction requirements.
  • Examples are documented for web and mobile.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Product designer, I want documented grid and breakpoint rules, so that web screens adapt predictably across supported viewport sizes.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints are defined.
  • Page max-width, gutters and column behavior are documented.
  • Tables define responsive behavior for narrow screens.
  • No critical action becomes unreachable at supported sizes.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Product owner, I want an accessibility standard for the product, so that users can operate the product with fewer barriers.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Target WCAG 2.2 AA for core workflows.
  • Visible focus styles are defined.
  • Minimum touch target is 44x44 CSS pixels for primary interactive controls.
  • Color is not the only carrier of status meaning.
  • Form errors are programmatically associated with fields.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Make Arabic the default experience while supporting complete English LTR behavior.

Title 3: US005 - Set Arabic as default product locale
Description: As a Farm user, I want the application to open in Arabic by default, so that I can use the product immediately in my preferred default language.
Acceptance Criteria:
• New unauthenticated sessions default to Arabic unless an explicit saved preference exists.
  • Arabic pages render with RTL direction.
  • Locale preference persists after sign-in.
  • English remains selectable from supported language controls.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US006 - Support complete English LTR experience
Description: As a Farm user, I want to switch the product to English, so that I can work in English without layout defects.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Language can be switched without losing the current task where technically feasible.
  • English pages render LTR.
  • Navigation, forms, tables, dialogs and charts remain usable after switching.
  • Preference persists per user.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US007 - Localize validation and system messages
Description: As a Farm user, I want validation, success and error messages in my selected language, so that I understand what happened and what action to take.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Required-field, format, authorization and server error messages are localized.
  • No raw backend exception is shown to end users.
  • Fallback behavior is defined for missing translations.
  • Arabic and English copy is reviewed for terminology consistency.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Frontend developer, I want explicit RTL behavior for components and data, so that Arabic screens behave naturally rather than being mechanically mirrored.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Navigation order, alignment and directional icons have documented RTL rules.
  • Numbers, IDs, QR/RFID values, email addresses and technical codes preserve readable direction.
  • Charts and timelines define RTL behavior.
  • Directional icons are mirrored only where meaning requires it.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Establish code, API, environment and delivery conventions for the product.
As a Developer, I want a clear repository structure for web, mobile, backend and authentication theme, so that the codebase is maintainable from the first release.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Repositories or monorepo boundaries are documented.
  • Shared linting, formatting and commit conventions are configured.
  • Secrets are excluded from source control.
  • README includes local startup instructions.

Description: As a Developer, I want a consistent REST/OpenAPI contract, so that web and mobile can integrate predictably with Spring Boot.
Acceptance Criteria:
• OpenAPI is generated and versioned.
  • Error response shape is standardized.
  • Pagination, sorting and filtering conventions are documented.
  • Date/time and identifier formats are standardized.

Description: As a Developer, I want automated checks on every pull request, so that defects are caught before merge.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Build, lint and automated test jobs run for affected applications.
  • Failed quality gates block merge.
  • Artifacts are versioned.
  • Pipeline does not expose secrets in logs.

Description: As a Developer, I want separate local, dev, test and production configuration, so that deployments are repeatable and safe.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Environment-specific values are externalized.
  • Secrets are stored outside source control.
  • Local development has documented defaults.
  • Production configuration changes are auditable.

Description: Provide secure authentication, authorization, user setup and first-run experience using Keycloak.
Deliver a branded OIDC login experience aligned with the HerdCommand UI.

Title 3: US013 - Implement HerdCommand Keycloak login theme
Description: As a Farm user, I want the authentication screen to match the HerdCommand visual design, so that login feels like part of the product.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Login theme uses HerdCommand logo, colors, typography and spacing.
  • Arabic is default and RTL is correct; English LTR is supported.
  • Username/email and password fields use Keycloak-managed authentication.
  • Validation, loading and disabled states are styled consistently.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US014 - Implement OIDC authorization code flow with PKCE
Description: As a Developer, I want web and mobile clients to use a secure standard login flow, so that credentials are not handled directly by application code.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Authorization Code + PKCE is used for public clients.
  • Access token is used for protected API calls.
  • ID token is used only for authenticated identity context.
  • Token refresh and logout behavior are implemented safely.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to reset a forgotten password, so that I can regain access without administrator intervention.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Forgot password is available from login when enabled.
  • Reset flow is completed through Keycloak.
  • Success and failure messages are localized.
  • Expired or reused reset links are handled safely.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US016 - Handle session expiration and logout
Description: As a Farm user, I want clear session behavior, so that I know when I need to sign in again.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Logout terminates the intended application session.
  • Expired sessions redirect to authentication without exposing protected content.
  • Unsaved-work behavior is defined for interactive forms.
  • Session messages are localized.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Control access according to each team member’s responsibilities.
As a Farm administrator, I want standard roles for owner, manager, veterinarian, worker, accountant and administrator, so that permissions are understandable and manageable.
Acceptance Criteria:
• A permission matrix is documented for standard roles.
  • Backend authorization enforces protected operations.
  • UI hides or disables actions the user cannot perform without relying on UI as the security boundary.
  • Role changes take effect according to the documented session policy.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to invite a new team member, so that they can join the farm with the correct role.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Admin enters invitee identity and role.
  • Invitation has an expiry policy.
  • User joins only the intended farm context.
  • Duplicate or invalid invitations are handled.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to change a member’s role, so that access can evolve with responsibilities.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Admin can view current role and choose an allowed new role.
  • Change is audited.
  • Unauthorized role escalation is prevented.
  • Affected user permissions update according to session policy.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to deactivate a member without deleting historical data, so that former staff cannot access farm data.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Deactivated user cannot establish a new authorized session for the farm.
  • Historical records retain the user reference.
  • Action requires confirmation.
  • Deactivation is audited.

Description: Guide a new customer from first login to a usable farm workspace.
As a Farm owner, I want a guided first-run experience, so that I understand the minimum setup needed to start.
Acceptance Criteria:
• First login opens onboarding until mandatory setup is complete.
  • Progress can be resumed after interruption.
  • Steps are available in Arabic and English.
  • User can access help text without leaving the flow.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm owner, I want to create the initial farm profile, so that I can start managing livestock.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Required farm fields are validated.
  • Farm is associated with the authenticated owner.
  • Default locale and currency settings are stored.
  • Successful creation routes to the next onboarding step.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm owner, I want to see what remains before setup is complete, so that I can finish configuration confidently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Checklist shows completed and pending setup items.
  • Completion criteria are deterministic.
  • Completed onboarding does not reopen unless explicitly launched from help/settings.
  • Completion event is auditable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Maintain farm identity, locations, operating settings and reference data.
Maintain the business and operational identity of the farm.
As a Farm manager, I want to view the farm profile and operating settings, so that I can confirm the active configuration.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Profile shows name, contact details, locale, timezone and configured currency.
  • Sensitive settings respect permissions.
  • Data is presented in the selected language.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to update farm information, so that records and reports use current details.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Authorized user can edit supported profile fields.
  • Validation prevents invalid mandatory values.
  • Changes are audited.
  • Updated values are reflected in subsequent reports and communications.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US026 - Configure farm timezone and locale
Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to configure timezone and locale settings, so that dates and times are interpreted correctly.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Timezone is selected from supported IANA zones.
  • Stored timestamps remain unambiguous.
  • Displayed dates/times respect user/farm context rules.
  • Locale change does not corrupt stored data.

Description: Model physical areas used to organize animals and operations.

Title 3: US027 - Create farm location or pen
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to define pens, barns or grazing areas, so that animals and tasks can reference real locations.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Location has unique name/code within the farm.
  • Type and active status are recorded.
  • Inactive locations cannot be newly assigned.
  • Creation is auditable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US028 - Edit and deactivate farm location
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to maintain the location list, so that obsolete areas stop being used without losing history.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Location can be edited while preserving identity.
  • Deactivation requires confirmation when active animals are assigned.
  • Historical references remain readable.
  • Unauthorized users cannot change locations.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to view animals assigned to a selected location, so that I can perform field work efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Location view shows current assigned animals.
  • User can search and filter the list.
  • Counts match the active assignment data.
  • Mobile layout supports quick field use.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Manage reusable classifications used across the farm.
As a Farm administrator, I want to manage supported animal breeds, so that animal records use consistent classifications.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Breed can be created, edited and deactivated.
  • Duplicate active breed names are prevented within the farm context.
  • Existing animals retain historical breed references.
  • Breed names support Arabic and English labels where configured.

Title 3: US031 - Manage health and finance categories
Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to configure supported categories, so that records and reports remain consistent.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Categories can be added, edited, ordered and deactivated.
  • System-required categories cannot be removed if needed for core behavior.
  • Historical records remain valid after deactivation.
  • Changes are audited.

Description: Give farm users an actionable view of herd status, pending work and key alerts.
Provide a concise daily operating picture.
As a Farm manager, I want to see key herd metrics at a glance, so that I can quickly understand current status.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Dashboard shows active animal count and configured lifecycle/health KPIs.
  • Metrics are scoped to the user’s farm and permissions.
  • Data timestamp or refresh behavior is clear.
  • Cards are responsive on web and mobile.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to see items requiring action, so that I can prioritize work.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Dashboard surfaces overdue tasks, upcoming vaccinations, due health actions and configured operational exceptions.
  • Each alert links to the relevant record or action.
  • Resolved alerts no longer appear after data refresh.
  • Empty state is clear when no action is required.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want quick access to common tasks, so that I can record field activity with fewer steps.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Quick actions include permitted high-frequency actions such as add animal, record weight, record treatment and scan.
  • Actions shown respect role permissions.
  • Mobile actions are reachable with one-handed interaction patterns where possible.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US035 - Filter dashboard by operational context
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to filter dashboard metrics by supported context, so that I can focus on relevant animals or groups.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Supported filters are clearly identified.
  • Selected filter updates all compatible dashboard widgets consistently.
  • A reset action restores default scope.
  • Filter state does not leak across unauthorized scopes.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Provide a readable history of significant farm actions.
As a Farm manager, I want to see recent significant events, so that I can understand what changed recently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Timeline includes key animal, health, breeding, inventory and team events.
  • Each entry shows timestamp, actor and target where available.
  • Entries are ordered consistently and are permission-filtered.
  • User can open the related record.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Create a reliable source of truth for each animal and its identifiers.
Create complete animal records with validated identifiers.
As a Farm manager, I want to create an animal record, so that the animal can be tracked throughout its lifecycle.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Required fields include primary identifier and animal type/species configuration.
  • Gender, breed, birth date, origin and current location/group can be captured when applicable.
  • Duplicate active primary identifiers are prevented within the farm.
  • Created animal appears in search and list views.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US038 - Register animal with unknown birth date
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to record an animal when exact birth date is unavailable, so that the registry reflects real field conditions.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can mark birth date as estimated or unknown according to product rules.
  • Age presentation clearly distinguishes estimates.
  • Data validation does not force false precision.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to add a photo to an animal, so that the animal is easier to identify visually.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can upload/capture supported image types.
  • File size and type are validated.
  • Image is stored securely and linked to the animal.
  • User can replace the primary photo without deleting historical events.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Find animals quickly using identifiers and operational filters.
As a Farm user, I want to view animals I am allowed to access, so that I can browse the herd.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List shows key identity and status fields.
  • Pagination or incremental loading handles large herds.
  • Archived/deceased/sold animals are visually distinct or excluded by default according to filter rules.
  • Arabic/English layouts remain readable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to search by tag, QR/RFID or name, so that I can find the correct animal quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Search supports configured primary and secondary identifiers.
  • Exact identifier matches are prioritized.
  • No-result state provides a clear recovery action.
  • Search respects farm scope and permissions.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US042 - Filter and sort animal list
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to filter and sort the animal list, so that I can work with targeted subsets.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Filters include supported values such as gender, breed, age/status, group and location.
  • Filters can be cleared individually and globally.
  • Sort behavior is deterministic.
  • Filter/sort works with pagination.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Provide a single operational view of an animal.
As a Farm user, I want to view an animal’s current summary, so that I can make informed decisions.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Profile shows identity, lifecycle status, group/location, latest weight and key health/breeding summary according to permissions.
  • Primary actions are visible and role-aware.
  • Missing optional information uses clear empty states.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to correct or update editable animal details, so that the registry stays accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Editable fields are clearly separated from immutable/system fields.
  • Identifier changes follow uniqueness rules.
  • Changes are audited.
  • Validation prevents logically inconsistent values where rules are known.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to see an animal’s chronological history, so that I can understand its lifecycle.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Timeline includes registration, movement, weight, breeding, health and lifecycle events.
  • Events link to details where applicable.
  • Timeline can be filtered by event category.
  • Historical entries are not silently altered by later master-data changes.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Connect physical animal identifiers with digital records.

Title 3: US046 - Assign QR code to animal
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to associate a QR identifier with an animal, so that the animal can be opened by scanning.
Acceptance Criteria:
• QR identifier is unique within the permitted scope.
  • Assignment is auditable.
  • Existing assignment conflicts are blocked or resolved through an explicit workflow.
  • Generated/printed code points to a safe application route, not sensitive data.

Title 3: US047 - Scan QR code on mobile
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to scan an animal QR code, so that I can open the correct animal quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Camera permission is requested only when needed.
  • Valid code opens the matching animal profile.
  • Invalid, unknown and unauthorized codes have distinct safe messages.
  • Scanner can be cancelled without losing navigation state.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US048 - Assign and scan RFID identifier
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to store and use RFID identifiers, so that RFID-enabled workflows can identify animals.
Acceptance Criteria:
• RFID value follows configured format/uniqueness rules.
  • Manual entry is supported where direct device integration is unavailable.
  • Unknown RFID produces a clear no-match result.
  • Identifier changes are audited.

Description: Track major lifecycle transitions without deleting history.

Title 3: US049 - Record animal sale or transfer out
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to mark an animal as sold or transferred out, so that active herd counts remain accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User records effective date and optional destination/reference.
  • Animal is removed from active operational lists by default.
  • Historical records remain accessible.
  • Transition is audited.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to record an animal death, so that herd records remain accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User records date and optional cause/notes.
  • Animal becomes inactive for future operational actions.
  • Existing historical health, weight and breeding data remains accessible.
  • Transition requires confirmation and is audited.

Description: Organize animals into operational groups and maintain movement history.
Create and manage operational animal groups.

Title 3: US051 - Create a flock or group
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to create an operational animal group, so that I can manage animals collectively.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Group has name, type/status and optional location/purpose.
  • Active name/code uniqueness is enforced where configured.
  • Creation is auditable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US052 - Add animals to a group
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to assign selected animals to a group, so that I can organize field operations.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can select one or multiple eligible animals.
  • Rules prevent invalid assignment when exclusivity applies.
  • Group counts update after assignment.
  • Assignment is captured in animal history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US053 - Remove animals from a group
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to remove animals from a group, so that group membership stays current.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can remove one or multiple eligible animals.
  • Removal effective time is recorded.
  • Historical membership remains available.
  • Counts refresh consistently.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to view group summary and members, so that I can understand group status.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Profile shows member count, location/purpose and relevant health/weight summaries.
  • Member list supports search/filter.
  • Actions respect permissions.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Track movement between locations and groups.
As a Farm worker, I want to record movement of animals, so that current location stays accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User selects source/target context and effective date/time.
  • Bulk movement supports multiple eligible animals.
  • Movement updates current location and preserves history.
  • Invalid target or unauthorized scope is blocked.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to review where an animal has been, so that I can investigate operational history.
Acceptance Criteria:
• History shows from/to location/group, effective date and actor where applicable.
  • Entries are ordered chronologically.
  • Historical movements remain readable after location deactivation.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Manage reproductive lifecycle and lineage from mating through offspring.
Record mating and breeding activity.
As a Farm manager, I want to record a breeding/mating event, so that reproductive history is traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Eligible female and sire can be selected according to configured rules.
  • Event date and breeding method can be recorded.
  • Duplicate accidental entries can be detected or corrected.
  • Event appears in both animals’ timelines when applicable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to view reproductive events for an animal, so that I can understand breeding status.
Acceptance Criteria:
• History lists breeding events and linked pregnancy/lambing outcomes.
  • Events are ordered by date.
  • User can open event details.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Track pregnancy checks and expected due dates.
As a Veterinarian, I want to record pregnancy check results, so that the farm can plan upcoming births.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Result supports pregnant, not pregnant and inconclusive where configured.
  • Check date, method and notes can be recorded.
  • Pregnant result can calculate/record expected due date.
  • Result is added to animal history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US060 - View animals due for lambing
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to see pregnant animals approaching due date, so that I can prepare resources.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List is based on recorded expected due dates/status.
  • User can filter by due window and group/location.
  • Overdue animals are visually identifiable.
  • Opening a row navigates to the relevant animal/pregnancy.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Veterinarian, I want to close a pregnancy with its actual outcome, so that pregnancy status remains accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Outcome can link to lambing, loss or other supported closure reason.
  • Closed pregnancy no longer appears as currently pregnant.
  • Outcome date is validated relative to pregnancy events.
  • Change is auditable.

Description: Record births and connect offspring automatically to lineage.
As a Farm manager, I want to record a lambing event, so that birth outcomes and offspring are tracked.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Event records dam, date/time, birth outcome and number of offspring.
  • User can create one or more offspring records from the event.
  • Offspring are linked to dam and sire when known.
  • Pregnancy status is closed appropriately.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US063 - Record multiple offspring in one lambing
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to create twins/triplets from one event, so that each offspring has an individual record.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Each offspring can have gender, identifier, status and birth weight.
  • All offspring share the same lambing event reference.
  • Validation prevents duplicate identifiers.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US064 - Record birth complications or loss
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to record complications and non-surviving offspring, so that reproductive and health reporting is accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Supported outcomes can be recorded without forcing creation of an active animal record.
  • Notes and relevant health follow-up can be captured.
  • Sensitive details respect role permissions.

Description: Display lineage relationships for breeding decisions.
As a Farm user, I want to view parents and known ancestors, so that I can understand lineage.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Pedigree shows known dam and sire and configurable ancestor depth.
  • Unknown relationships are clearly shown.
  • Opening a known ancestor navigates to its permitted profile.
  • Pedigree remains usable in RTL and LTR.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want the system to validate parent assignments, so that lineage data remains credible.
Acceptance Criteria:
• An animal cannot be its own ancestor.
  • Configured sex/age rules are validated where data is known.
  • Circular pedigree relationships are prevented.
  • Override behavior, if allowed, requires appropriate permission and audit.

Description: Record health observations, treatments and preventive care with traceable history.
Capture observations, diagnoses and veterinary notes.
As a Veterinarian, I want to record a health observation or diagnosis, so that the animal health history is complete.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Event records date, category, notes and responsible user.
  • Relevant attachments can be added where permitted.
  • Event appears on animal health history.
  • Required clinical fields vary by configured category rather than one oversized form.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to view chronological health records, so that I can understand current and historical issues.
Acceptance Criteria:
• History lists health events, treatments and vaccinations according to permissions.
  • User can filter by health record type.
  • Open issues are visually distinguishable from completed events where applicable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Record treatment plans and medication administration.
As a Veterinarian, I want to record a treatment for an animal, so that medication and care are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Treatment records medication/item, dose, route, date and notes when applicable.
  • Medication can reference inventory item.
  • Invalid or inactive items cannot be newly selected.
  • Treatment is included in animal health history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Veterinarian, I want to schedule repeated treatment actions, so that farm staff can complete a treatment course.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Plan can define frequency/duration or explicit occurrences.
  • Upcoming treatment actions can generate tasks/reminders.
  • Each administration can be completed independently.
  • Plan status reflects completed/missed/cancelled occurrences.

Description: As a Veterinarian, I want to record a withdrawal end date when relevant, so that operational decisions can respect medication restrictions.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Active withdrawal is visible on the animal profile.
  • Relevant reports/alerts can identify active withdrawal status.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Plan and record vaccinations.
As a Veterinarian, I want to record a vaccination, so that preventive care history is complete.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Inventory can be decremented when integration is enabled.
  • Next due date can be calculated or entered.
  • Record appears in health history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to see animals with upcoming or overdue vaccinations, so that I can plan preventive care.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List supports due-window filtering.
  • Overdue items are clearly identified.
  • User can open the animal or vaccination action.
  • Completed vaccination no longer appears as due.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Veterinarian, I want to plan the same vaccination for a group, so that bulk preventive care is easier to manage.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can target a group/filter of eligible animals.
  • Campaign creates planned vaccination actions without duplicating existing completed records.
  • Progress shows planned, completed, skipped and remaining counts.

Description: Track growth and plan nutrition using consistent measurements and feed records.
Record weights and visualize growth.
As a Farm worker, I want to record a new weight, so that growth can be monitored.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Units are displayed consistently according to product configuration.
  • Unreasonable values trigger validation or confirmation rather than silent acceptance.
  • Latest weight updates the animal summary.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to record weights for multiple animals efficiently, so that weighing sessions are faster.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Each row validates independently.
  • Partial progress can be saved safely.
  • Recorded weights appear in each animal history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to visualize an animal’s weight over time, so that I can identify growth trends.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Chart plots dated weight measurements in chronological order.
  • Data points expose value/date details accessibly.
  • No-data and single-point states are handled.
  • Chart layout works in Arabic RTL and English LTR.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to identify animals outside configured growth expectations, so that I can intervene earlier.
Acceptance Criteria:

Description: Maintain feed items and feeding schedules.
As a Farm manager, I want to maintain feed types used by the farm, so that feeding and inventory records use consistent items.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Feed item has name, unit and active status.
  • Optional nutrition attributes can be stored when configured.
  • Inactive feed cannot be selected for new plans.
  • Existing history remains readable.

Title 3: US080 - Create feeding plan for group
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to define a feeding plan for a flock/group, so that staff know what to feed and when.
Acceptance Criteria:

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to record actual feed delivered, so that planned and actual feeding can be compared.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User records group/location, feed item, quantity and date/time.
  • Inventory can be decremented when configured.
  • Record is traceable to the actor.
  • Mobile entry minimizes required typing.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Calculate and save practical ration mixes.
As a Farm manager, I want to define a ration from multiple feed ingredients, so that feeding plans can reuse consistent mixes.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Recipe supports multiple ingredients and quantities/percentages.
  • Total composition is validated according to configured basis.
  • Recipe has version/effective status behavior.
  • Inactive ingredients are not available for new versions.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US083 - Estimate ration quantities for group
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to scale a ration for a selected group and period, so that I know required feed quantities.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Calculation uses explicit inputs such as group count, daily rate and duration.
  • Inputs and calculated totals are visible.
  • Rounding rules are consistent.
  • Calculation can be used to create a feeding plan without overwriting the recipe.

Description: Track feed, medicines and operational stock with clear quantity history.
Maintain stock items and units.
As a Store manager, I want to create a stock item, so that inventory movements reference a consistent catalog.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Item includes name, category, unit and active status.
  • Optional SKU/batch tracking settings can be configured.
  • Duplicate identifiers are prevented where configured.
  • Creation is audited.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to view stock quantities and status, so that I can understand current supply position.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List shows on-hand quantity and low-stock status where configured.
  • User can search/filter by category and active status.
  • Quantities are calculated from valid stock movements.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Record receipts, issues, adjustments and consumption.
As a Store manager, I want to record incoming stock, so that on-hand quantity is accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Receipt records item, quantity, date and optional supplier/batch/expiry.
  • Quantity must be positive.
  • On-hand stock updates after successful save.
  • Movement is auditable.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US087 - Record stock issue or consumption
Description: As a Store manager, I want to record stock leaving inventory, so that on-hand quantity stays accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Issue records item, quantity, date and purpose/reference.
  • Insufficient-stock behavior follows configured policy.
  • Movement can link to feeding or treatment record.
  • On-hand quantity updates consistently.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Store manager, I want to correct stock after a physical count, so that system quantity matches reality.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Adjustment requires reason and actual/adjustment quantity.
  • Only authorized roles can adjust stock.
  • Before/after values are retained in audit history.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to be alerted when stock drops below a configured threshold, so that I can replenish before running out.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Threshold can be configured per item where enabled.
  • Alert is raised only when calculated on-hand crosses the relevant rule.
  • Acknowledgement does not change stock quantity.
  • Alert links to the inventory item.

Description: Track suppliers and simple purchase records without building full ERP scope.
As a Farm manager, I want to maintain supplier contact information, so that purchases and inventory records can reference suppliers.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Supplier has name, contact details and active status.
  • Deactivated suppliers remain on historical records.
  • Duplicate validation is applied to configured identifiers.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Accountant, I want to record an inventory-related purchase, so that costs and receipts are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Purchase can reference supplier, date, items, quantities and total amount.
  • Farm currency is used for monetary fields.
  • Receipt/document can be attached.
  • Purchase can create stock receipts only through an explicit confirmation step.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Coordinate daily work and surface important events to the right users.
Create, assign and complete operational tasks.
As a Farm manager, I want to create an operational task, so that work can be tracked to completion.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Task includes title, due date, priority and optional assignee/related record.
  • Task can link to animal, group, health or inventory context.
  • Creation respects permission rules.
  • Task is visible to relevant users.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US093 - Assign task to team member
Description: As a Farm manager, I want to assign a task, so that responsibility is clear.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Only active eligible users are assignable.
  • Assignee receives configured notification.
  • Assignment change is audited.
  • Unauthorized users cannot assign outside their scope.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to mark assigned work as complete, so that the team sees current progress.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can complete an eligible task and optionally add completion notes.
  • Completion timestamp and user are recorded.
  • Completed task leaves active due lists.
  • Linked workflow can update only through explicit supported rules.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want to schedule repeated operational work, so that routine activities do not need manual recreation.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Recurrence supports defined supported patterns.
  • Future occurrences are generated according to a documented strategy.
  • Editing recurrence distinguishes single occurrence vs series where supported.
  • Stopping recurrence does not delete completed history.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Provide in-app and push/email notifications with user control.
As a Farm user, I want to see recent notifications, so that I can catch up on important events.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Notifications show type, message, time and read/unread status.
  • Opening a notification navigates to the related authorized context.
  • Read state can be updated.
  • List is localized.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to receive important alerts on my mobile device, so that I can react while away from the desktop.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Push permission is requested appropriately.
  • Notification content avoids sensitive detail on lock screen where policy requires.
  • Tapping notification deep-links to an authorized screen after authentication if needed.
  • Invalid/expired deep links fail safely.

Description: As a Farm user, I want to control optional notification categories/channels, so that I receive useful alerts without unnecessary noise.
Acceptance Criteria:
• User can manage supported optional channels/categories.
  • Mandatory security notifications cannot be disabled if policy requires.
  • Preference changes persist per user.
  • Default preferences are documented.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Record farm financial activity and provide decision-ready operational reports.
Record financial transactions relevant to farm operations.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Creation/change is audited.

Description: As a Accountant, I want to record farm income, so that financial reporting includes revenue.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Amount uses configured farm currency.
  • Transaction can optionally reference animal/group sale context.

  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Accountant, I want to search and filter income and expenses, so that I can reconcile farm activity.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List supports date range, type and category filters.
  • Totals reflect the active filter.
  • User can open authorized transaction details.
  • Large result sets are paginated/exportable according to permissions.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Deliver reusable operational and financial reports.
As a Farm manager, I want a report of animals by key classifications, so that I can understand herd composition.
Acceptance Criteria:

  • Counts reconcile with source records.
  • Filters are shown in the report context.
  • User can drill to underlying animals where supported.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US103 - Run breeding and reproductive performance report
Description: As a Farm manager, I want a report of breeding, pregnancy and lambing outcomes, so that I can evaluate reproductive operations.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Report uses defined metrics with documented calculation rules.
  • Date range and group filters are supported.
  • Missing data is not silently treated as zero when semantics differ.

Title 3: US104 - Run health and vaccination report
Description: As a Veterinarian, I want a report of health events and preventive care, so that I can review herd health activity.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Report supports health/vaccination category and date filters.
  • Upcoming/overdue preventive care can be separated from completed history.
  • Access respects health data permissions.

Title 3: US105 - Run weight and growth report
Description: As a Farm manager, I want a report of weight trends and exceptions, so that I can compare groups and animals.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Report supports date range and group/location filters.
  • Metric definitions are consistent with dashboard/chart logic.
  • Users can identify animals behind summary values where authorized.

Description: As a Farm owner, I want to view income, expenses and net result for a period, so that I can assess farm financial performance.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Report shows period totals by supported categories.
  • Currency and rounding are consistent with farm configuration.
  • Totals reconcile with included transactions.
  • Access is restricted to authorized finance roles.

Description: Export permitted reports for offline use or stakeholder sharing.
As a Farm user, I want to export a permitted report to PDF, so that I can share a readable fixed-format report.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Export includes report title, generated timestamp and active filters.
  • Arabic export renders RTL text correctly.
  • PDF does not include data the user cannot access.
  • Large exports fail gracefully with a clear message or asynchronous flow.

Title 3: US108 - Export tabular report to spreadsheet
Description: As a Farm user, I want to export permitted report data to a spreadsheet-compatible file, so that I can perform offline analysis.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Export columns match visible/report semantics.
  • Date and numeric values remain machine-readable.
  • Arabic and English text exports correctly.
  • Export respects active filters and permissions.

Description: Support reliable field work on React Native, including intermittent connectivity.
Provide native mobile navigation and core farm workflows.
As a Farm user, I want a clear mobile navigation structure, so that I can reach common areas quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Primary destinations align with approved mobile information architecture.
  • Navigation supports Arabic RTL and English LTR.
  • Back behavior follows platform conventions.
  • Protected routes require authenticated session.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Title 3: US110 - Provide mobile home quick actions
Description: As a Farm worker, I want quick mobile access to field workflows, so that I can record activity with minimal taps.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Home exposes permitted quick actions such as scan, weight, treatment and task completion.
  • Actions adapt to role and offline availability.
  • Touch targets meet accessibility baseline.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Keep critical field data available during connectivity loss.

Title 3: US111 - Cache assigned operational data for offline use
Description: As a Farm worker, I want critical farm and animal data available offline, so that I can continue field work with poor connectivity.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Offline dataset scope is explicitly limited to required records.
  • Cached data is encrypted or protected according to platform capability and threat model.
  • User can see when data was last synchronized.
  • Logout clears protected cached data according to security policy.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want to know whether the app is online, offline or syncing, so that I understand whether changes are current.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Connectivity/sync state is visible without blocking normal work.
  • Offline state does not incorrectly report successful server synchronization.
  • Recovering connectivity starts sync according to defined policy.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Queue supported changes locally and synchronize them safely.

Title 3: US113 - Record supported field action while offline
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to record supported actions without connectivity, so that work is not lost in the field.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Supported offline actions are explicitly defined.
  • Offline save creates a local pending record with unique client identifier.
  • User sees pending sync status.
  • Unsupported online-only actions clearly explain the limitation.

Description: As a Farm worker, I want pending changes to synchronize when connectivity returns, so that server records become current without duplicate submissions.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Sync is idempotent for retried client operations.
  • Successfully synced items leave pending state.
  • Failed items remain actionable with reason/status.
  • Sync can resume after app restart.

Description: As a Farm manager, I want a safe way to handle conflicting offline and server edits, so that valid data is not silently overwritten.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Conflict is detected using version/timestamp strategy for supported entities.
  • User is shown meaningful differences for manual-resolution cases.
  • Resolution outcome is audited where business data changes.
  • System never silently drops a user change.

Description: Optimize QR/RFID workflows for field operation.

Title 3: US116 - Scan animal and launch contextual actions
Description: As a Farm worker, I want to scan an animal then choose a relevant action, so that I can move directly from identification to work.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Successful scan opens animal context with permitted quick actions.
  • Offline scan works for cached identifiers.
  • Actions unavailable offline are clearly marked.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Operate the platform securely with auditability, observability and production readiness.
Provide controlled administration of users, settings and reference data.
As a Farm administrator, I want to review active/invited/deactivated team members, so that I can manage access centrally.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Dashboard separates active, invited and deactivated users.
  • Role and last relevant access status are shown where permitted.
  • Admin actions are available only to authorized users.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to manage supported farm-level application settings, so that behavior can be configured without code changes.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Only approved settings are exposed.
  • Values are validated before save.
  • Security-sensitive changes require elevated permission and audit.
  • Settings have safe defaults.

Description: Create a trustworthy history for sensitive business changes.
As a Farm administrator, I want sensitive changes to be traceable, so that I can investigate who changed what and when.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Audit records actor, timestamp, action and target identifier.
  • Before/after values are captured only for approved non-secret fields.
  • Audit records are append-only to normal application users.
  • Access to audit views is restricted.

Description: As a Farm administrator, I want to search audit history, so that I can investigate incidents and changes.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Authorized user can filter by date, actor, action and target type.
  • Results are paginated.
  • Audit search does not expose secrets or hidden sensitive fields.
  • Where UI is present, Arabic is supported as the default RTL experience and English is supported as LTR.

Description: Detect failures and understand platform health.
As a Developer, I want structured logs with correlation identifiers, so that production issues can be traced across services.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Requests have correlation/trace identifiers.
  • Logs avoid passwords, tokens and secrets.
  • Log levels are environment configurable.
  • Key business failures include safe diagnostic context.

Title 3: US122 - Implement metrics and health checks
Description: As a Operator, I want service health and core metrics, so that I can detect degraded behavior.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Backend exposes protected/appropriate health endpoints.
  • Metrics cover request latency/error rate and key infrastructure dependencies.
  • Health checks distinguish readiness from liveness where deployment platform supports it.

Description: As a Developer, I want web and mobile runtime errors to be observable, so that I can prioritize real user failures.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Unhandled errors are captured with release/environment context.
  • Personally sensitive values and tokens are excluded.
  • Source-map handling does not expose production source publicly.

Description: Apply production security controls across application and infrastructure.

Title 3: US124 - Enforce API authorization in Spring Boot
Description: As a Security engineer, I want every protected API operation to validate authenticated identity and permissions, so that UI bypass cannot expose protected data.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Spring Security validates token issuer/audience according to configured policy.
  • Endpoint/service authorization is enforced server-side.
  • Unauthorized and forbidden responses are distinct and safe.
  • Automated tests cover representative role boundaries.

Title 3: US125 - Implement secure file upload controls
Description: As a Security engineer, I want uploaded files to be validated and isolated, so that malicious files cannot be treated as trusted content.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Allowed type and size rules are enforced server-side.
  • Object keys are generated rather than trusted from user filenames.
  • Downloads require authorization.
  • Executable content is not served inline unless explicitly safe.

Title 3: US126 - Apply web security headers and CORS policy
Description: As a Security engineer, I want web/API transport policies to be explicit, so that browser-based attack surface is reduced.
Acceptance Criteria:
• CORS allows only required origins/methods/headers.
  • Security headers are configured for production.
  • HTTPS is required in production.
  • Configuration is tested in deployment environment.

Description: Protect business data and validate recovery procedures.

Title 3: US127 - Configure PostgreSQL backup and restore process
Description: As a Operator, I want tested database backups, so that farm data can be recovered after failure.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Backup frequency and retention are documented.
  • Backups are encrypted according to platform policy.
  • Restore procedure is tested in a non-production environment.
  • Recovery objectives are documented and approved.

Title 3: US128 - Define attachment retention and recovery
Description: As a Operator, I want a retention strategy for object storage, so that files remain consistent with business records and recovery needs.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Retention/lifecycle policy is documented.
  • Deletion behavior is consistent between metadata and object storage.
  • Recovery expectations for accidentally deleted files are documented.

Description: Validate the product before production release.
As a Product owner, I want core workflows to meet agreed response targets, so that the product remains usable at expected scale.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Performance targets are defined for key APIs/pages before testing.
  • Representative data volumes are used.
  • Slow queries/endpoints are identified and remediated or accepted explicitly.
  • Results are recorded for release evidence.

Description: As a Product owner, I want a formal release readiness checklist, so that known operational risks are visible before go-live.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Security, backup, observability, rollback, migration and support readiness are reviewed.
  • Open critical defects block release.
  • Known accepted risks have owner and mitigation.
  • Go-live decision is recorded.
